name: Flawless Fist
description: Punch with a fist faced in a flawless crystal that carries the force without a crack or a scatter.

name: Flawless Plate
description: Raise a plate of flawless crystal whose even structure spreads a blow without breaking.

name: Flawless Stride
description: Stride along a clear flawless line laid ahead in crystal qi and lose no pace of the gap.

name: Flawless Cut
description: Cut along a flawless plane that pierces the guard and breaks the opponent's rhythm.

name: Flawless Ward
description: Hold a ward of flawless crystal before the body that gives the blows no weak point to find.

name: Flawless Eye
description: Look through a flawless lens of crystal and find the weak plane in an armour or a wall.

name: Flawless Edge
description: Draw a flawless edge across the target in one stroke that parts the guard along its seam.

name: Flawless Mantle
description: Spread a mantle of flawless crystal over the user and the nearest allies and steady each of them.

name: Perfect Facet
description: Cut one perfect facet in the qi field and loose the focused force through it in a bolt that nothing turns.

name: Adamant Knuckle
description: Punch with a fist hardened to the hardest crystal so the blow breaks what it meets.

name: Adamant Plate
description: Raise a plate hardened past any blade and let the blow ring on it unharmed.

name: Adamant Stride
description: Stride on hardened crystal pads that do not give under the weight of the body.

name: Adamant Dart
description: Throw a hardened dart of crystal that goes through leather and pins the cloth behind.

name: Adamant Cut
description: Cut with a hardened edge so that the strike lands and the opponent's weapon is knocked askew.

name: Adamant Hold
description: Hold the hardened crystal shell over the body through a long press of heavy blows.

name: Adamant Splint
description: Grow a hardened crystal splint over an ally's broken limb that holds the bone true as it knits.

name: Adamant Crash
description: Bring down a block of hardened crystal that crushes the guard and the arm beneath it.

name: Adamant Burst
description: Burst the hardened shell outward in a ring of edged crystal that cuts every foe near.

name: Diamond Edge
description: Draw the hardest edge in one perfect cut that parts armour and guard and shakes the foe's balance.

name: Refracted Fist
description: Punch through a crystal lens so the blow seems to come from a place a hand's breadth to one side.

name: Refracted Plate
description: Raise a plate that bends light and force around its edge and so lessens the blow it takes.

name: Refracted Step
description: Step through a bend of crystal light and come out two paces from where the eye expects.

name: Refracted Glint
description: Send a bright bolt through a crystal lens that bends in flight and hits from the side.

name: Refracted Sight
description: Look through bent crystal light to see round a pillar or over a rise.

name: Refracted Lance
description: Bend a lance of qi through two crystals so it strikes from the flank and rattles the opponent.

name: Refracted Veil
description: Hold a veil of bending crystal that turns a thrust a handbreadth wide of the body.

name: Refracted Return
description: Catch a thrown force in the bending crystal and send it back along a new angle at the thrower.

name: Refracted Volley
description: Split a single bolt through a field of crystals into many that strike each foe near.

name: Refracted Pierce
description: Focus the bent light to a single point and drive it through the guard to the body beneath.

name: Lance Refracted
description: Bend the great lance through the whole crystal field so it falls on each foe from a different angle.

name: Pinnacle Fist
description: Punch upward with a fist tipped in a narrow crystal point that drives into the chin.

name: Pinnacle Plate
description: Raise a steep slanting plate that sheds a blow to either side of the body.

name: Pinnacle Stride
description: Rise on a small crystal spire grown beneath the feet and step down on the far side of the gap.

name: Pinnacle Rise
description: Raise a spire under the opponent's stance that lifts and holds them and strikes as it rises.

name: Pinnacle Guard
description: Hold a ring of low spires about the body that break the force of blows from every side.

name: Pinnacle Cleansing
description: Raise a small clear spire at an ally's feet that draws poison down out of the body.

name: Pinnacle Impale
description: Drive a tall spire up through the ground and the foe's guard in one swift thrust.

name: Pinnacle Cluster
description: Raise a cluster of spires beneath a group of foes so that each of them is struck from below.

name: Spire Eternal
description: Raise one great spire that impales the foe and holds them fixed on its point.

name: Cleaved Fist
description: Punch with a fist set to split along its flat so the blow parts whatever it strikes.

name: Cleaved Plate
description: Raise a plate that splits a blow in two and lets the halves fall to either side.

name: Cleaved Step
description: Step through a cold clean split in the qi field and come out beyond the blow.

name: Cleaved Shard
description: Break a long shard from the plate and fling it with the cold edge forward.

name: Cleaved Sight
description: Find the faint split in a foe's armour or posture that a clean stroke could follow.

name: Cleaved Edge
description: Slice along the weak plane of the guard so the strike lands and the arm behind is thrown wide.

name: Cleaved Guard
description: Split an incoming strike with a cold crystal edge and send the halves wide of the body.

name: Cleaved Seal
description: Close a crystal seam over the opponent's qi channel so that the flow stops for a time.

name: Cleaved Clearing
description: Cut a clean line through a curse clinging to an ally and let the two halves fall away.

name: Cleaved Fall
description: Bring a cold edge down in one stroke that splits the guard and the arm beneath it.

name: Cleaved Storm
description: Send cold clean edges flying through the whole group of foes in a single storm of cuts.

name: Cold Cleavage
description: Draw the final cold cleavage across the foe so the cut falls on the body itself and no armour turns it.

name: Sixfold Fist
description: Punch with a fist faced in a six-sided crystal that lands on its flat and spreads the force.

name: Sixfold Plate
description: Raise a six-sided plate whose even edges share a blow's weight round the whole rim.

name: Sixfold Pace
description: Step along tiles of six-sided crystal and keep a perfect rhythm over rough ground.

name: Sixfold Sense
description: Spread a thin six-sided web of crystal and feel which cell is touched and by whom.

name: Sixfold Ward
description: Hold a ward of six faces round the body so that the load of a blow is shared across them all.

name: Sixfold Cage
description: Close six crystal faces round one opponent until they cannot move out of the cell.

name: Sixfold Mend
description: Grow a six-sided crystal lattice over an ally's wound to hold the flesh in its true form.

name: Sixfold Bloom
description: Open six great petals of crystal outward from the user and cut each foe they reach.

name: Sixfold Aegis
description: Raise a shared sixfold ward over the nearby allies so each stands behind one of its faces.

name: Hexagon Eternal
description: Raise a perfect six-sided ward that shelters the user and locks the nearest foes inside its walls of crystal.

name: Clustered Fist
description: Punch with a knot of small crystals grown over the knuckles that bite as they land.

name: Clustered Plate
description: Grow a plate of tightly packed crystals over the front of the body in a single breath.

name: Clustered Stride
description: Raise a small cluster under each foot as it falls and stride on the crystal pads.

name: Clustered Growth
description: Seed a crystal at the opponent's feet and let a cluster grow up the legs and set them fast.

name: Clustered Burst
description: Pop a ripe cluster so the crystals fly outward in a spray that strikes every foe near.

name: Clustered Salve
description: Grow a soft cluster of clear crystal across an ally's wound to close it and draw out the pain.

name: Clustered Crash
description: Drop a heavy cluster of crystal on the foe with the weight of all its points at once.

name: Clustered Revival
description: Grow a clear crystal over a fallen ally's heart and set it humming until the pulse returns.

name: Cluster Ascendant
description: Grow a vast cluster that rises beneath the foes and locks them in its crystal as it climbs.

name: Symmetric Fist
description: Punch with a fist and the mirrored fist behind it at once so the force is perfectly balanced.

name: Symmetric Plate
description: Raise two matched plates of crystal either side of the body so a blow meets equal resistance.

name: Symmetric Pace
description: Take matched steps on matched pads of crystal so the body never leans to one side.

name: Symmetric Dart
description: Throw twin darts of crystal from either hand that strike two matched points on the target.

name: Symmetric Sight
description: Compare the left and right of the field through mirrored crystal and find what is out of place.

name: Symmetric Shell
description: Close a matched shell round the body that gives equal strength on every side.

name: Symmetric Return
description: Return a blow through the matching plane with exactly the force and angle it arrived with.

name: Symmetric Cage
description: Close two matched halves of crystal round one opponent until they meet and lock.

name: Symmetric Purge
description: Draw the taint out of an ally's body in two matched streams of clear crystal light.

name: Symmetric Crash
description: Bring both matched crystal fists together on the foe so the blow lands with doubled and even weight.

name: Symmetric Bloom
description: Open matched petals of crystal on both sides of the user and cut each foe within their sweep.

name: Symmetric Aegis
description: Stand with the nearby allies and match a shared crystal aegis to each of them evenly.

name: Symmetry Perfected
description: Hold a perfectly symmetric field that takes each force in and returns every part of it exactly as it came.
